test_title: PYST 46: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The logic followed here is based on the alphabetical position pattern:

Option 1: WYZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5ba29ab3aed6a84907309d52541c75ed95c3478c886e3488e0630af4a93c53e.png] 

Option 2: IJL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3276a370fef34657b32c1cca7ca5d01d294b6863441460e42584faaf306dc113.png] 

Option 3: STV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecc7da948fa08e04005d4b5a2a72cc96619b7c812058b0cdf8b83bc29accd9c.png] 

Option 4: HIK

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bacf794f6a0f48c9cbe7255816ddbda3ef91783dd7c572ae104b8501fa6013c3.png] 

Thus, WYZ does not follow the pattern.

Hence, the odd one out is **Option 1.**
